name: Taknema
author: mhamedi3d

sections.description:
Taknema is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to prevent duplicate content from being displayed across different pages of your website. It supports various page builders including Elementor, WooCommerce, Visual Composer, Beaver Builder, and Divi.

Key Features

  • Flexible Storage: Choose between Session (faster) or Transient (more stable) storage methods
  • Page Selection: Control which pages should apply the duplicate prevention filter
  • Content Types: Select specific post types to filter (posts, pages, products, custom post types)
  • Category Exceptions: Exclude specific categories from filtering
  • Debug Mode: Administrator-only debug information for troubleshooting
  • Full Compatibility: Works seamlessly with Elementor, WooCommerce, and other popular page builders

Supported Page Builders

  • Elementor
  • WooCommerce
  • Visual Composer (WPBakery)
  • Beaver Builder
  • Divi Builder
  • Gutenberg (WordPress Block Editor)

Use Cases

  • Prevent showing the same post on homepage and category pages
  • Avoid duplicate products in WooCommerce listings
  • Create unique content experience across different archive pages
  • Improve user experience by showing fresh content on each page

External Services

This plugin connects to an external service hosted at https://mhamedi.ir/taknema/admin/track.php to collect anonymous usage statistics for plugin improvement purposes.

What Data is Collected

The following information is sent to our server:

Site domain and URL
Site name
Administrator email address
WordPress version
Plugin version
PHP version
Server IP address
Plugin activation/deactivation status and dates

When Data is Sent

Once when the plugin is first activated
Once when the plugin is deactivated
Once per week for status updates

Why We Collect This Data

This data helps us understand how the plugin is being used and identify areas for improvement. No personal user data, content, or visitor information from your website is collected.

Service Provider

This service is operated by Mohammad Hamedi (the plugin developer).

Service Homepage: https://mhamedi.ir/taknema
Privacy Policy: https://mhamedi.ir/taknema/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://mhamedi.ir/taknema/terms-of-service

Data Protection

All data transmissions are encrypted via SSL/TLS. We do not share collected data with third parties.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the taknema folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Taknema menu in WordPress admin to configure your preferences
  4. Select your desired storage method and target pages
  5. Choose which content types should be filtered
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor?

Yes! Taknema fully supports Elementor and its post widgets.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Absolutely! Taknema seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce product listings and shop pages.

What’s the difference between Session and Transient storage?

Session storage is faster and suitable for most sites. Transient storage uses the WordPress database and may be more stable for sites with session limitations.

Can I exclude specific categories?

Yes, you can exclude both post categories and WooCommerce product categories from the filtering.

Does it affect site performance?

Taknema is lightweight and optimized for performance. The Session storage method has minimal impact on site speed.
